name: Ride to Work
tagline: Start cycling to work and keep doing it
about: Ride to Work gets you commuting by bike: a build-up plan for your distance and fitness, what to wear for today's weather, the right bike and lock setup, route-choosing rules, and the real savings versus driving or transit.
persona: You are a friendly bike-commute mentor: safety-first without scaremongering, practical about sweat, rain and dark mornings, and encouraging to beginners.

onboarding.title: Swap the traffic for a ride
onboarding.subtitle: Distance and terrain shape your plan.
bullets: A build-up plan you can stick to

tools.title: First four weeks
tools.subtitle: Build up days per week without burning out

inputs.label: Constraints
inputs.placeholder: shower at work, kids drop-off Tuesdays, start 8:30

tools.prompt: A 4-week bike-commute build-up for the profile distance and terrain, fitness '{fitness}', with constraints: {constraints}. Table (Week | Days riding | Which days | Fallback plan), steps for the night-before routine, a checklist for the very first ride (weekend test ride, time it, find the shower), and a callout on the most common week-2 dropout reasons and how to beat them.

tools.title: What do I wear today?
tools.subtitle: Weather → layers, gloves, visibility
tools.prompt: For '{weather}', arriving {style}, over the profile distance: kv (top, bottom, hands, feet, head, eyes), a checklist to pack (dry socks, lights, lock), bullets on sweat and rain management, and a callout on visibility rules for the dark.

tools.title: Choose my commuter
tools.subtitle: Bike, e-bike, folding or fix what you have

inputs.label: Needs
inputs.placeholder: carry laptop, hills, no secure parking at work

tools.prompt: Recommend a commuter setup for the profile with budget {budget} and needs: {needs}. Cards for 3 options (meta = price · weight · maintenance), a table (Option | Hills | Carrying | Theft risk | Sweat), a checklist of must-have extras (lights, mudguards, rack, lock) with rough costs, and a callout on second-hand red flags.

tools.title: Route & security rules
tools.subtitle: Pick a route, lock it, don't lose it

inputs.label: Route options
inputs.placeholder: main road 20 min or canal path 30 min, parking on street

tools.prompt: Given: {route} — bullets comparing the options by risk, time and stress, steps for a smart locking routine (what to lock to, two-lock method, wheels and saddle), a checklist for bike registration and insurance, and a callout on the highest-risk junction types and how to position.

tools.title: What I'll save
tools.subtitle: Bike vs car vs transit, honestly
tools.prompt: Compare cycling {days} days a week with the current: {current}. Table (Option | Weekly cost | Yearly cost | Minutes door-to-door | CO2 est.), kv (yearly saving, payback on the bike, calories per week est.), bullets on hidden costs (tyres, chain, rain gear), and a callout on cycle-to-work or tax schemes to ask HR about.

disclaimer: General guidance only; obey local road rules, wear a helmet where required and have the bike fitted and checked by a mechanic before regular riding.
